{{wireless adapter |brand=Sweex |model=LW324 |if=USB |if_bus_version=2.0 |fcc_id= |vendor_id= |device_id= |chip1_brand=Ralink |chip1_model=RT3072 |flags= |802dot11_protocols=bgn |txchains=2 |rxchains=2 |sstreams=2 }}[http://www.sweex.com/nl/connectedhome/client_adapters/LW324/ Product page]
The Sweex drivers include an ID marked as the LW324 - 177f:0324. The device is also mentioned as having a 32Mb (4MB) NOR flash, presumably for driver installation. Per [http://rt2x00.serialmonkey.com/pipermail/users_rt2x00.serialmonkey.com/2011-September/004208.html this post on the rt2x00 mailing list], the device has a 148f:2870 ID (strange, 148f:3072 would be expected) and a non-standard RF ID which is currently preventing its usage in Ralink Linux drivers.
